{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the generic term applied to a vessel's second in command|[[First Mate (Slith)|First Mate]], a title in [[Slith]] society}}
{{Quote|Chewbacca here is first mate on a ship that might suit us.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''First Mate''', alternatively '''first mate''', was a title usually held by the second in command of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other vessels.

[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was First Mate to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
